worldState._boostsNote: CLIENT-VISIBLE global boosts (like DE event boosts; client applies AND shows them live, so they also inflate what the client reports to the server). The NUMBER is the on/off switch for all four: 0 (or absent) = OFF/vanilla, 2 = DE's authentic event strength, 3/5/... = stronger. Do NOT use 1 (client shows a pointless x1 banner). creditBoostMultiplier/affinityBoostMultiplier/resourceBoostMultiplier are the sole owners of ordinary credits, affinity, and live resource pickups. The named privateServerTuning reward-path multipliers apply only to server-generated reward rows and do not re-multiply client-reported pickup counts. modDropChanceMultiplier exposes GAMEPLAY_PICKUP_RATE and was confirmed visible in-game on 2026-07-16.

_notes._comment: Each multiplier owns one named server reward path. These fields multiply the quantity of a reward chosen once; they do not add reward-table rolls. None of them touch resources picked up in the level, ordinary credits, affinity, Focus, or Ducat sales. Credit bundles are excluded because the native world-state credit boost owns credits.
_notes.enabled: false = this whole section is ignored (stock behaviour; this file ships that way). true = apply it to the accounts in targetEmails/targetDisplayNames, or to every account when both lists are empty. Note: when enabled, the nemesis*Multiplier values are written to each targeted inventory and override the web UI values.
_notes.serversideQualityOfLife: helminthSubsumeHours: Helminth subsume timer in hours (24 = stock, 0 = instant). syndicateStandingCapacity: usable standing at the final syndicate rank (0 = stock cap).
_notes.missionTypeRewardMultipliers: Exact DE mission-type owners for server-generated node reward rows. Examples: MT_SURVIVAL=Survival, MT_DEFENSE=Defense, MT_EXCAVATE=Excavation, MT_TERRITORY=Interception, MT_ARTIFACT=Disruption, MT_EXTERMINATION=Exterminate, MT_CAPTURE=Capture, MT_ASSASSINATION=boss/Assassination. Unknown future mission types default to 1. Dedicated systems below take priority and never stack.
_notes.spyVaultRewardMultiplier: Spy vault reward-table rows identified by VaultsCracked. This is separate from MT_INTEL and enemy caches.
_notes.enemyCacheRewardMultiplier: Ordinary hidden enemy-cache reward-table rows identified by EnemyCachesFound. Event, Alert and Quest requests retain their dedicated owner.
_notes.railjackMissionRewardMultiplier: Main Railjack mission reward-deck rows, guaranteed Pontis completion Talents (normal 12-16 / Steel Path 18-22 base), and Steel Path completion Steel Essence (2 base). Does not multiply travel-stage pickups.
_notes.railjackMandatoryObjectiveRewardMultipli: Railjack abandoned-cache Rotation A rows from mandatory POI objectives.
_notes.railjackOptionalObjectiveRewardMultiplie: Railjack abandoned-cache Rotation B rows from optional loot dungeons.
_notes.railjackEndOfMissionBonusResourceBundleM: OpenWF's Railjack completion bonus: two independent faction resource-bundle rolls (duplicates allowed) for most Grineer/Corpus Railjack nodes, or one special Arcane roll for CrewBattleNode560/561. Nemesis showdown nodes CrewBattleNode557/558/559 are excluded. These are server-generated MissionRewards rows, not resources picked up while flying.
_notes.railjackVoidStormRewardMultiplier: Void Storm reward-table rows and their paired Granum Bucks rows.
_notes.bountyRewardMultiplier: Open-world, Zariman, Entrati Lab, Hex and Nokko bounty-stage or bounty-completion reward rows identified by jobId or challengeMissionId.
_notes.alertRewardMultiplier: World-state Alert mission reward rows identified by alertId.
_notes.sortieRewardMultiplier: Regular Sortie final reward rows. A value of 1 means vanilla quantity.
_notes.archonHuntRewardMultiplier: Archon Hunt final Archon Shard and reward-deck rows. A value of 1 means vanilla quantity.
_notes.eventMissionRewardMultiplier: World-state Goal/event mission reward rows identified by goalId or GoalTag.
_notes.questMissionRewardMultiplier: Quest and mission-key reward rows identified by LevelKeyName.
_notes.duviriMissionRewardMultiplier: Duviri encounter, portal, Orowyrm and related T-coded mission reward rows outside the Circuit reward track.
_notes.periodicMissionRewardMultiplier: Periodic and special mission rows such as Steel Path Incursions, Arbitrations, Nightmare missions, Kuva Siphon/Flood mission rewards, invasions, Orokin Vaults and Purgatory. Kuva items still use kuvaRewardMultiplier.
_notes.netracellRewardMultiplier: Netracell mission rows and the authoritative stripped-container reward grant. The same multiplied count is persisted and returned to the client.
_notes.circuitRewardMultiplier: Circuit mission reward rows and advertised Circuit reward-track item quantities. Circuit progress points remain controlled separately by circuitProgressMultiplier.
_notes.calendar1999RewardMultiplier: Multiplies item and pack quantities claimed from 1999 calendar reward days once. Calendar buffs/challenges and booster duration retain their native behavior; missing or 1 means normal quantities. Separate from mission, Archon Hunt and daily-login rewards. Calendar preview has no verified quantity field; InventoryChanges returns the actual grant.
_notes.entropicKuvaRewardMultiplier: Entropic Kuva mission rewards and client-reported gains only. Replaces the delivery-path multiplier; does not stack with regular Kuva or mission multipliers. 1 = unchanged. Does not multiply purchases, refunds or spending.
_notes.kuvaRewardMultiplier: Owns Kuva reward rows and Kuva client inventory updates. It replaces the current delivery-path multiplier and never stacks with it.
_notes.circuitProgressMultiplier: Multiplies Circuit (Duviri) progress earned per run.
_notes.deepArchimedeaMultiplier: Owns Elite Deep Archimedea reward counts directly. It never inherits or stacks with another multiplier; 1 means vanilla quantity.
_notes.temporalArchimedeaMultiplier: Owns Elite Temporal Archimedea reward counts directly. It never inherits or stacks with another multiplier; 1 means vanilla quantity.
_notes.descendiaMultiplier: Owns Descendia floor reward counts directly, including Archon Shards. It never inherits or stacks with another multiplier; 1 means vanilla quantity.
_notes.dailyLoginMultiplier: Multiplies daily login tribute reward counts (Endo/credits/resources/recipes; boosters have no count to scale). Default 1 = off.
